S1_HUM_M|There is another important thin: There is another important thing I want to show you: I can upgrade almost every building in your town to make it more efficient and more beautiful. You will love this, I promise!

S1_HUM_M|Well, that Encounter was a bit: Well, that Encounter was a bit strange. But we got a mysterious Relic that will certainly increase our knowledge of this Province. Very good.
S1_HUM_M|What a nice spot you found! I'm: What a nice spot you found! I'm Ronan the Builder. Old Aldon sent me to guide you through your first steps. If you want to build a big city, we should start right away.
